notes.title: Matrix Games is the new Home of Combat Mission
notes.content:
Hi everyone,

We are excited to announce the acquisition of Battlefront, the renowned developers behind the Combat Mission series. 

ELEVATING COMBAT MISSION'S LEGACY
This strategic move underscores our commitment to the wargaming community and the legacy of Combat Mission—a franchise celebrated for its unmatched tactical and strategic depth. With over 1 million copies sold worldwide, Combat Mission remains a defining force in the genre, setting the standard for authentic warfare simulations.

[previewyoutube=u3OwoL7A4RE;full][/previewyoutube]

LOOKING FORWARD
This acquisition marks a new chapter for Combat Mission, as we plan to enhance the series with cutting-edge technology and innovative gameplay, all while preserving the core elements that have made it a favorite among wargamers for over 25 years.

Battlefront's entire team, including the original creators, will be joining Slitherine, ensuring the continuity and quality that fans have come to expect.

This partnership makes a milestone in wargaming, with Slitherine and Battlefront committed to delivering the best possible experience and ensuring the continued growth and success of the Combat Mission franchise.

AVAILABILITY & DISTRIBUTION
Combat Mission titles will continue to be available on all current platforms, including Matrix Games and Steam. To help both new and existing players, we have updated our FAQ and "How to Download My Games" sections, making it easier than ever to access and enjoy the series.

A DAY OF CELEBRATION
To celebrate this exciting milestone, we're thrilled to offer discounts of up to 60% on all Combat Mission titles. This is a limited-time sale, available until September 3rd, so don't miss out: https://store.steampowered.com/sale/combatmissionfranchisesale


Additionally, we have organized a full day of streaming on our Twitch channel. The schedule includes a variety of Combat Mission titles, showcasing gameplay and strategies. Join us to experience our streamers in action and engage with our community.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/43772341/81576c3109a93360acd451e5856c3d135c4091e5.jpg

We are also pleased to announce the opening of subscriptions for a new Battle for Normandy tournament featuring three brand new maps. These maps have been meticulously crafted, all starting from the master map of the Battle Pack 2.

Enjoy this Combat Mission milestone and celebration and don’t miss this perfect opportunity to expand your collection and dive into the acclaimed tactical warfare series at an unbeatable price.

notes.title: Combat Mission Black Sea - Update v02.18.00
notes.content:
We are proud to announce the release of pbem+++ and tournament support for Combat Mission: Black Sea.

You will soon be able to participate in official tournaments and play multiplayer matches to test your skills against other players.

Here is the changelog:

NEW
• ADDED: Matrix/Slitherine PBEM++ and Tournament feature
BUG FIXES
• Corrected a problem with T-90 frontal armor
• FIXED: Multi-team HQ units block out UI information at end-of-game
• FIXED: AI gets confused with two targets and enters a cycle of turning the turret back and forth 
and never choosing a target

We are excited to offer these new features to the dedicated community of Combat Mission players. Thanks for your patience and have fun.
